facts.value: QTEM (Quantitative Techniques for Economics and Management)
The QTEM program includes one or two semesters abroad and an internship. The aim of the program is to deepen analytical and quantitative skills.
QTEM Track 1: 1 semester abroad + an internship of 240 hours; QTEM Track 2: 2 semesters abroad + an internship of 240 hours.
All QTEM students participate in the QTEM Global Business Analytics Challenge (GBAC, 8 ECTS), which includes group work on a business case and two preparatory courses.
A total of 50 ECTS points in quantitative courses must be completed, with 22 ECTS per semester abroad at one of the QTEM partner universities.
The master's thesis will be written at the home university in Frankfurt.
A GMAT score of at least 555 points is required for participation in the QTEM program.
An equivalent GRE score (e.g., 155 in Verbal Reasoning and 159 in Quantitative Reasoning) is also accepted.
A new GMAT test format was introduced starting the fourth quarter of 2024. The previous format will still be accepted with a minimum score of 600.
The application deadline for the academic year 2026/27 is February 1, 2026.
New application announcements will be published at the end of October each year, with the application deadline being February 1 of the following year.

Students from the first semester of the master's programs in Business Administration (BWL), Management Science (Mgmt Sc.), Money, Macro and Finance (MMF), and International Economics and Economic Policy (MIEEP) can apply.
